name: com.retro.pausemenu
description: Esc-driven pause menu with Continue / Save / Load / Options / Quit, slot-based JSON saves, and a PlayerPrefs settings store. Integrates with any game via IPauseTarget / ISaveParticipant / ISettingsTarget; optional adapter assemblies light up automatically for the First Person Controller, Retro Inventory and Retro PS1 Post-Processing packages.
